A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was an uncle to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl [[Reina Gale]]. After Gale was orphaned by a virus, her uncle took her into his custody. He eventually [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] away his entire fortune, and even Gale, to a local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="Gambler">{{JournalCite|4|It's a Gambler's Life}}</ref>
